component.name: WireRunner
component.summary: Understand and control the PipeWire media graph

description.p: WireRunner presents audio, video, and MIDI objects in one direct graph so people can understand the current signal path and make intentional changes.
Adds remembered WirePlumber device Route controls, per-channel volume, pointer-centered wheel zoom, and live wire movement.
Adds per-node master volume and mute controls with PipeWire-confirmed state.
Improves graph clarity under fractional scaling and separates socket routing from card dragging.
Adds direct port routing, exact-link removal, feedback protection, and undo and redo.
Adds the composed, navigable graph foundation with stable layout.
